as_told.title: Non-human biologics recovered with craft (hearing clip)

plain: Several people on the show say that when the US government secretly recovered crashed craft, it also recovered bodies or biological remains, which insiders call biologics, and that these were not human. The main teller is David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer turned whistleblower, who tells Michels that, as he said in an earlier television interview, "Biologics came with some of these recoveries." In a clip from his testimony before Congress, played on the show, he is asked whether they were human or non-human and answers "non-human", saying that was the assessment of people with direct knowledge who are still on the program. Grusch says he is passing on what others told him, and names the congresswoman Nancy Mace and the journalist Ross Coulthart around that account. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he took part in retrieving a UFO, puts it more loosely: there are "reports" that biologics are in storage and "we just don't know what that is", without tying them to particular crashes. The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says he has heard the same, adding that it is "mostly autopsy reports." If true, it would mean the government holds the remains of beings that are not human.
